record_title: On-slice Cesàro laws for multinomial modes
provenance: SCOPE Phase II scientific record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The theorem assumes rational linear independence of the probability vector and gives Cesàro rather than pointwise limits. Rational or otherwise arithmetically nongeneric vectors require separate treatment. The explicit multiplicative calculation is carried through Q2. Older apportionment moment literature, including two nearby papers whose full texts were not inspected, remains the principal residual originality risk.

artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic highest-averages check of the low-order Cesaro formulas for the generic three-category example.
